workload.note: Limited by a foot injury for part of the season but returned for the playoffs (chicagobears.com camp preview). 6 TDs on 44 catches despite missing 5 games.

contract.note: 4-year, $22,724,500 rookie contract (2024-2028 per Spotrac), fully guaranteed signing bonus $13,346,908. 2 years remaining as of 2026, with a 5th-year team option available for 2028/2029. Not extension-eligible yet in 2026; scheduled for unrestricted free agency in 2029 absent action.

scheme.oc: Ben Johnson (HC, play-calling background as former Lions OC)
scheme.note: Ben Johnson is Bears head coach (hired prior to 2025 season); no OC change specifically identified for 2026 in sources checked, but WR Kalif Raymond was specifically brought in for his prior connection to Johnson from Detroit.

competition.name: DJ Moore
competition.note: Per chicagobears.com camp preview, Moore -- who led Bears receivers in 2025 -- was traded to the Buffalo Bills, removing the team's top target ahead of Odunze. This is a significant target-share opening for Odunze in 2026.

competition.name: Luther Burden III
competition.note: 47 receptions, 652 yards, 2 TD in 2025 (rookie year). HC Ben Johnson (end of May 2026 OTAs): 'I'm buying Luther Burden stock right now.'

competition.name: Kalif Raymond
competition.note: Age 31 going on 32; signed for his familiarity with Ben Johnson's scheme from Detroit.

competition.name: Colston Loveland
competition.note: Per chicagobears.com, Loveland (TE) had a higher 2025 receiving total than Odunze, indicating a crowded target tree even with Moore gone.

notes: Apr 30, 2026 SI depth-chart article lists Odunze as WR1 on the Bears' post-draft depth chart (ahead of Burden, Raymond, Jahdae Walker, Zavion Thomas, JP Richardson) -- though this predates the DJ Moore trade context noted in the later camp preview; DJ Moore's departure appears to be the more recent, decision-relevant change.
Odunze quote (date unspecified, chicagobears.com preview): 'I feel like for me, I'm trying to be excellent in every single category.'

injury.status: Fully recovered, full participant in offseason program and camp
